question:
The marks scored by 10 students are given below.

18, 10, 15, 18, 18, 13, 20, 18, 17, 19

The mode of the given data is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The mode of a dataset is the observation that appears the highest number of times.

In the given data: 18, 10, 15, 18, 18, 13, 20, 18, 17, 19.

We can clearly observe that the number 18 appears 4 times, which is more frequent than any other number.

**∴ The correct answer is 18 marks.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marks scored by 10 students: 18, 10, 15, 18, 18, 13, 20, 18, 17, 19

**Concept Used:**

Mode = The value of the observation having the maximum frequency in a data set.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let us arrange the given marks in ascending order to easily count the frequencies.

⇒ Ascending order: 10, 13, 15, 17, 18, 18, 18, 18, 19, 20

⇒ Frequency of 10 = 1

⇒ Frequency of 13 = 1

⇒ Frequency of 15 = 1

⇒ Frequency of 17 = 1

⇒ Frequency of 18 = 4

⇒ Frequency of 19 = 1

⇒ Frequency of 20 = 1

⇒ Since 18 occurs the maximum number of times (4 times) in the dataset, it is the mode.

**∴ The correct answer is 18 marks.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mean

Mean is the arithmetic average of a dataset, calculated as the sum of all observations divided by the total number of observations.

Median

Median is the middlemost value of a dataset when arranged in either ascending or descending order. For an even number of observations, it is the average of the two middle values.

Empirical Relationship

For a moderately skewed distribution, the empirical relationship between mean, median, and mode is given by: Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean.

Bimodal Data

If a given dataset has two distinct values with the same highest frequency, the dataset is called bimodal (having two modes).
